Errata slip of [[A Brave Resistance (Errata)]] (PC-E1), marked “E”, from the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_032021.pdf#page=2 Errata Sheet 2021 Spring] ("Official text as of March 19, 2021"), page 2, Light Side. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005195534/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_032021.pdf Internet Archive].

Edits: none. This is the card image embedded in the PDF, extracted losslessly (pdfimages) at its own size, 745 × 1011.
